notes.title: This is a difficult decision, we designed the technology tree.
notes.content:
This is a difficult decision. For the sake of freedom, we opened up all construction options, but it confuses novice players. The construction column expands, and there are more than one hundred buildings to choose from. Players don't know where to start. Therefore, we designed the technology tree to guide players in order to play the game by the unlocking process, and hope to not interfere with the player's game process as much as possible.

The layout of the entire interface has also been greatly changed. It was streamlined at the beginning. Players first place the core and start to generate technology points (beaker icon), and then determine the unlocked items in the technology tree menu and build. There are also some existing buildings and new buildings that can provide more technological points output.

The buildings of the new version of the interface are divided into three types, production, defense and attack. Some construction units have been changed from construction to placement, such as torches. Therefore, the original building options have been reduced a bit. For veterans, please search for these items in your bags.

A random box has been added. When a group of monsters are cleared, there is a chance to drop the box. The box has four colors, blue, red, green and purple. They drop resources, equipment, weapons, and rare items respectively.

The menu for editing the appearance of the character has been opened in the new building: Barbershop. Players need to spend a few technological points to unlock them before they can build.

Other changes are as follows:
1. The location of the lumber yard was changed to the location of the tree (originally around the tree)
2. Two new laboratories are added for research and development of technology.

Bug fix:
1. The problem that landmines will not explode.
2. The player stops advancing after attacking.
3. Correction of building prompt position.
